reading.significance: As an affordable digital anthology, this volume served readers discovering Dick's short fiction through screen adaptations -- 'Adjustment Team' (The Adjustment Bureau, 2011), 'Sales Pitch' and 'Human Is' (Electric Dreams), and 'The Golden Man' (loosely, Next, 2007) -- providing low-friction access to stories otherwise scattered across older, harder-to-find print anthologies.
reading.closing_note: This entry documents the anthology as a publishing object; readers seeking analysis of individual stories should consult each story's own dossier elsewhere in this corpus.
